properties.description:

surf expected. Surf will build to 3 to 6 feet Sunday and persist
through Tuesday morning.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles
County Beaches.

* WHEN...From Sunday morning through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

may occur across south-facing beaches especially in the Long
Beach area.
properties.instruction:

stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.

properties.areaDesc: Guam Coastal Waters; Rota Coastal Waters
properties.headline: Typhoon Warning issued October 18 at 12:31PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Typhoon conditions, including winds of 64 knots or more will
continue for Guam. Tropical storm conditions will continue for
Rota.

* WHERE...Guam and Rota Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...Destructive typhoon force winds are occurring in western
waters of Guam, but will decrease as Champi moves farther west away
from the Marianas. The eye of Champi is now well outside of the
coastal waters to the west. Damaging winds will continue through
today.

* IMPACTS...Destructive typhoon force and tropical storm force winds
will produce dangerous to deadly seas that could damage, capsize or
sink vessels, along with drastically reducing visibilities in heavy
rain.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Super Typhoon Champi (29W) continues to move
quickly away from the Marianas as a Category 4 Super Typhoon. Seas
are expected to remain hazardous through tonight, with significant
sea heights as high as 24 feet over Guam coastal waters and 20
feet over Rota coastal waters. Dangerous sea conditions may
continue into Monday.
properties.instruction:
Conditions will remain catastrophic for small craft, and extremely
dangerous for any vessels of larger size over western waters of Guam
and Rota. Waters will remain hazardous across the remainder of the
waters. Stay in safe harbor until the all clear is given.

NWSheadline: TYPHOON WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT

properties.areaDesc: Tinian; Saipan
properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 18 at 12:19PM ChST until October 19 at 4:00AM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Tinian and Saipan.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM ChST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...As Super Typhoon Champi (29W) continues moving
away from the Marianas, southeast winds will remain elevated over
Saipan and Tinian and lasting at least through early Monday
morning.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution when driving on roads with no
center barriers, as well as when passing high profile vehicles.

properties.areaDesc: Lake Michigan from Seul Choix Point to Rock Island Passage 5NM offshore to Mid Lake; Lake Michigan South of a line from Seul Choix Point to the Mackinac Bridge and North of a line from Charlevoix MI to South Fox Island 5NM offshore; Lake Michigan from Charlevoix to Point Betsie MI 5NM Offshore to mid lake; Lake Michigan from Rock Island Passage to Sturgeon Bay WI 5NM offshore to mid lake
properties.headline: Gale Warning issued October 17 at 9:11PM CDT until October 19 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
waves 6 to 12 ft expected.

* WHERE...Northern Third of the Open Waters of Lake Michigan.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Sunday to 1 AM CDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.

properties.areaDesc: Sheboygan to Port Washington WI
properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 17 at 9:11PM CDT until October 18 at 10:00PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt. Waves
3 to 5 feet Sunday into Sunday evening.

* WHERE...Nearshore Waters from Sheboygan to Port Washington.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
properties.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
